niche_preference_profile: This user prefers interfaces that feel clean, airy, and well-structured, with strong visual hierarchy, concise copy, and clear grouping of content. They like layouts that show enough information to feel complete, but not so much that the screen feels crowded. They also prefer restrained, premium-looking styling over busy, colorful, or overly decorative UI, and they respond well to clear primary actions and straightforward navigation cues.

criteria.description: Prefers layouts with open spacing, light visual weight, and a breathable composition rather than dense or cramped screens.
Prefers a clear top-to-bottom hierarchy with one dominant focal area, distinct section separation, and obvious primary actions.
Prefers short, direct, task-focused copy over long explanatory text, verbose labels, or procedural wording.
Prefers a calm, polished, premium-looking interface with restrained styling rather than colorful, busy, or playful presentation.
Prefers screens that feel complete and informative, with enough visible content to be useful, but without excessive crowding.
Prefers content organized into clearly labeled groups or sections with balanced spacing and coherent structure.
Prefers an obvious main CTA that stands out clearly from secondary actions and is easy to identify at a glance.
Prefers straightforward navigation affordances such as clear back/next controls, chevrons, or simple step indicators.
Prefers settings and controls to be grouped in compact, contained areas rather than spread across many nested cards or fragmented blocks.
